what: Implement locked-in areas using a raster input
title: Using patchwise with locked-in and locked-out areas
text: generate data example, use data Bermuda generated via oceandatr. import basic planning data, patchwise readme. example use 40 x 40 raster planning grid cost value 1 cell, following features targeted prioritization: 4 random, binary (0 1) data layers, representing species distributions; example calling fish 3 “patches” contiguous features; example calling seamounts generate square within planning area used locked area Let’s look fish distributions, seamounts locked-area:  Now can continue using patchwise group seamount areas entire seamount ranges protected (portions seamounts) - process shown main patchwise readme, locked-area. data preparation now done, can run prioritization using prioritizr: comparison, run prioritization without using patchwise can now plot solutions, overlaying outlines seamounts (red), can see one entire seamount included solution used patchwise, whereas solution without patchwise selects planning units seamount. Note solution patchwise, planning units overlap seamounts entirely selected also selected meet targets features (fish distributions). square, locked-area included scenarios.
code: # Load libraries library(patchwise) library(terra) library(sf) library(prioritizr) #import planning units/ cost raster pu_raster <- rast(system.file("extdata/pu_raster.tif", package = "patchwise"))  #import fish distributions fish_distributions <- rast(system.file("extdata/spp_distributions.tif", package = "patchwise"))  #import seamounts seamounts <- rast(system.file("extdata/seamounts.tif", package = "patchwise")) locked_area <- as.polygons(ext(5, 15, 25, 35)) |>   rasterize(pu_raster, background = 0) |>   setNames("Locked-in") plot(c(fish_distributions, seamounts, locked_area)) # Create seamount patches patches_rast <- create_patches(seamounts)  # Create patches dataframe - this creates constraints so that entire seamount patches are protected patches_df_rast <- create_patch_df(spatial_grid = pu_raster, features = fish_distributions, patches = patches_rast, costs = pu_raster, locked_in = locked_area)  # Create targets for protection - 20% for each feature (including 20% of whole seamounts) targets_rast <- features_targets(targets = rep(0.2, (nlyr(fish_distributions) + 1)), features = fish_distributions, pre_patches = seamounts, locked_in = locked_area)  # Add these targets to targets for protection for the "constraints" we introduced to protect entire seamount patches constraints_rast <- constraints_targets(feature_targets = targets_rast, patch_df = patches_df_rast) plot(c(solution_no_patches, sol_rast_patches),      fun = function()lines(as.polygons(seamounts), col = "red"),      plg = list(legend = c("Not selected", "Selected")))

20% for each feature (including 20% of whole seamounts) targets_sf <- features_targets(targets = rep(0.2, ncol(features_sf)), features = features_sf, pre_patches = seamounts_sf, locked_in = locked_area_sf)  # Add these targets to targets for protection for the "constraints" we introduced to protect entire seamount patches constraints_sf <- constraints_targets(feature_targets = targets_sf, patch_df = patches_df_sf)  # Create the prioritization problem problem_patches_sf <- problem(x = patches_df_sf, features = constraints_sf$feature, cost_column = "cost") |>   add_min_set_objective() |>   add_manual_targets(constraints_sf) |>   add_binary_decisions() |>   add_default_solver()  # Solve the prioritization solution_patches_sf_tbl <- solve(problem_patches_sf) #> Set parameter Username #> Set parameter LicenseID to value 2865081 #> Set parameter TimeLimit to value 2147483647 #> Set parameter MIPGap to value 0.1 #> Set parameter Presolve to value 2 #> Set parameter Threads to value 1 #> Academic license - code: library(patchwise) library(prioritizr) library(terra) #import planning units/ cost raster pu_raster <- rast(system.file("extdata/pu_raster.tif", package = "patchwise"))  #import fish distributions fish_distributions <- rast(system.file("extdata/spp_distributions.tif", package = "patchwise"))  #import seamounts seamounts <- rast(system.file("extdata/seamounts.tif", package = "patchwise")) plot(c(fish_distributions, seamounts)) # Create seamount patches  patches_rast <- create_patches(seamounts)  # Create patches dataframe - this creates constraints so that entire seamount patches are protected  patches_df_rast <- create_patch_df(spatial_grid = pu_raster, features = fish_distributions, patches = patches_rast, costs = pu_raster) #> Processing patch 1 of 3 #> Processing patch 2 of 3 #> Processing patch 3 of 3 # Create targets for protection - 20% for each feature (including 20% of whole seamounts) targets_rast <- features_targets(targets = rep(0.2, (nlyr(fish_distributions) + 1)), features = fish_distributions, pre_patches = seamounts)  # Add these targets to targets for protection for the "constraints" we introduced to protect entire seamount patches constraints_rast <- constraints_targets(feature_targets = targets_rast, patch_df = patches_df_rast) # Convert the solution into a raster using the patchwise function `convert_solution()` sol_rast_patches <- convert_solution(solution = solution_patches_tbl, patch_df = patches_df_rast, spatial_grid = pu_raster) |>   setNames("With patchwise") plot(c(solution_no_patches, sol_rast_patches),       fun = function()lines(as.polygons(seamounts), col = "red"),      plg = list(legend = c("Not selected", "Selected"))) boundary_matrix_rast <- create_boundary_matrix(spatial_grid = pu_raster, patches = patches_rast, patch_df = patches_df_rast) plot(solution_rast_boundary, plg = list(legend = c("Not selected", "Selected"))) lines(as.polygons(seamounts), col = "red")
